notes: Piel "lead slowly" was requested but has zero attestation anywhere in the corpus -- both of this root's only two occurrences (Isa.38.15, Ps.42.5) are tagged Hitpael, not Piel, in the morphology. Excluded per the no-uncited-glosses rule; only Hitpael is shipped, and it is now this root's sole stem (no DEFAULT_STEM_OVERRIDE entry needed).

Ps.42.5's Hitpael form (אֶדַּדֵּם, "I led them") carries a transitive "lead" nuance close to the requested Piel sense, from the pronominal object suffix -- but it competes with Isa.38.15's bare אֶדַּדֶּה for the same yiqtol/1cs paradigm slot, and loses under the bare-form-preferred selection rule, so only the intransitive "walk deliberately" sense (Isa.38.15) is shown.
